study type: Cross sectional and prospective observational study
exposure: Intent to have a second child
intent on having a second child
Intent to have a second child (yes/no)
outcome: Preferred mode of delivery in second trimester
Preferred mode of delivery at admission
finding: Nulliparous women in China who intend to have a second child are less likely to request a caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women who intend to have a second child are less likely to request a CD, and high rates of CD and CDMR in nulliparous women may have decreased after implementation of China's two child policy.
